install: cc app.c -lthinkthen   # thinkthen.h and both libraries beside it

decide.c: int rc = thinkthen_decide(tt, "Is this a complaint?", evidence, strlen(evidence), &answer);

choose.c: door(tt, "choose", "{\"choose\":\"Which team owns this?\",\"options\":[\"the refund desk\",\"the maybe desk\",\"anywhere else\"],\"evidence\":\"please route this ticket\"}");

tag.c: door(tt, "tag", "{\"tag\":\"Which words appear?\",\"labels\":[\"refund\",\"shipping\"],\"evidence\":\"the refund and the shipping\"}");

filter.c: door(tt, "filter", "{\"decide\":\"Is this a complaint?\",\"records\":[\"good morning\",\"I demand a refund today\"]}");

rank.c: door(tt, "rank", "{\"decide\":\"Is this a complaint?\",\"rank\":true,\"records\":[\"good morning\",\"I demand a refund today\"]}");

find.c: door(tt, "find", "{\"find\":\"Which line asks for money back?\",\"units\":[\"good morning\",\"I want a refund\"]}");

annotate.c: door(tt, "annotate", "{\"annotate\":{\"questions\":{\"refund\":{\"decide\":\"Does the customer ask for a refund?\"},\"complaint\":{\"decide\":\"Is this a complaint?\",\"threshold\":0.5}}},\"records\":[\"maybe later\"]}");
